name: Greek Lemon Chicken & Potatoes
desc: Bone-in chicken thighs and potato wedges roasted in lemon, olive oil, garlic and oregano, with the potatoes broiled at the end.

source.title: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
source.evidence: Chef John's recipe: same 4 lb thighs, 3 russets, 1/2 cup each lemon juice and olive oil, 6 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp each kosher salt and oregano, 1 tsp rosemary, pinch of cayenne, and the same 425°F, 20 plus 25 minute roast with a final broil.

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup olive oil, plus more for the pan
2/3 cup chicken broth, plus about 1/3 cup to deglaze
1 tsp chopped fresh oregano, for garnish (optional)

steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Lightly oil a large roasting pan.
Put the chicken in a large bowl and season with the salt, oregano, pepper, rosemary, and cayenne. Add the lemon juice, olive oil, and garlic, then the potatoes, and toss until everything is coated.
Arrange the chicken skin side up in the pan, reserving the marinade, and tuck the potatoes between the thighs. Drizzle with the 2/3 cup broth and spoon the remaining marinade over everything.

Roast 20 minutes. Toss the potatoes, keeping the chicken skin side up, and roast about 25 minutes more, until the chicken is browned and reads 165°F near the bone. Move the chicken to a platter and keep warm.
Set the oven to broil. Toss the potatoes in the pan juices and broil about 3 minutes, until caramelized. Move them to the platter.
Set the roasting pan over medium heat on the stove, add the extra broth, and scrape up the browned bits. Strain the juices over the chicken and potatoes and sprinkle with fresh oregano.
